note: Paragraphs Collapsible is a zero-config, front-end-only enhancement of the Paragraphs module. It has NO settings form, configure route, permissions, Drush, config, or plugins. Its one PHP hook (paragraphs_collapsible_library_info_alter) makes its asset library a dependency of Paragraphs' drupal.paragraphs.admin library; its JS only enhances the CLASSIC paragraphs widget entity_reference_paragraphs (wrapper .field--widget-entity-reference-paragraphs), not the modern 'paragraphs' widget. Because the module itself stores nothing, the medium/hard cases are grounded in the real config that decides whether the feature applies: the paragraphs reference field's FORM WIDGET on entity_form_display. Medium cases read back which widget a seeded paragraphs field uses (and which of two fields the module will make collapsible); hard cases switch a paragraphs field's form widget to the classic entity_reference_paragraphs widget and build a new paragraphs field using that widget, verified against the live node.article.default form display.

evals.prompt: How do I turn on the collapsible expand/collapse feature for the Paragraphs edit widget using the paragraphs_collapsible module? Is there a settings page to configure?
evals.expected_output: There is no configuration and no settings page - just enable the paragraphs_collapsible module (e.g. drush en paragraphs_collapsible -y). On enable it attaches its JS/CSS to the Paragraphs admin widget automatically.

evals.prompt: Which Paragraphs field widget does the paragraphs_collapsible module actually enhance with collapse/expand controls, and how does it attach its assets?
evals.expected_output: It enhances the classic Paragraphs table widget (entity_reference_paragraphs, wrapper .field--widget-entity-reference-paragraphs), not the modern 'paragraphs' widget. It attaches by adding its library as a dependency of Paragraphs' drupal.paragraphs.admin library via hook_library_info_alter().

evals.prompt: What controls does the paragraphs_collapsible module add to the paragraphs editing widget, and which rows get them?
evals.expected_output: It adds an overarching Expand all / Collapse all button on the field label and a per-row [+]/[-] toggle button (with aria-expanded/aria-label) on each paragraph row that has a title (.paragraph-type-title). Rows with errors or newly AJAX-added content start expanded.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a Paragraphs reference field named field_pgc_body. paragraphs_collapsible only enhances one particular widget. Inspect the live default form display and tell me which form widget field_pgc_body uses.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_pgc_body component uses the classic 'entity_reference_paragraphs' widget - which is exactly the widget paragraphs_collapsible enhances.

evals.prompt: This site's Article content type has two Paragraphs fields, field_pgc_classic and field_pgc_modern, using different form widgets. Inspect the live form display and tell me which of the two the paragraphs_collapsible module will make collapsible.
evals.expected_output: field_pgc_classic - it uses the classic entity_reference_paragraphs widget which paragraphs_collapsible enhances, whereas field_pgc_modern uses the modern 'paragraphs' widget that the module does not touch.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Paragraphs field field_pgc_task that currently uses the modern 'paragraphs' form widget, so the paragraphs_collapsible collapse controls do not appear. Reconfigure the field's default form widget so that paragraphs_collapsible will enhance it, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Change the field_pgc_task component on core.entity_form_display.node.article.default to the classic 'entity_reference_paragraphs' widget (via Manage form display or setComponent()->save()), which is the widget paragraphs_collapsible enhances.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a new multi-value Paragraphs reference field named field_pgc_build to the Article content type, and configure its default form widget so the paragraphs_collapsible collapsible controls will apply to it. Apply everything to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an entity_reference_revisions field field_pgc_build (target_type paragraph) on node.article and set its default form-display widget to the classic 'entity_reference_paragraphs' widget, so paragraphs_collapsible will enhance it.
